login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Sign in with your e-mail and password.
login.resetDone: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new one.
login.why: Sign in and we will finish what you were doing.

register.title: Create an account
register.intro: One account to sell and to buy. Every message reaches you by e-mail.
register.emailHint: The confirmation link and every update reach you by e-mail only.
register.phoneHint: For contact only; never shown to anyone.
register.terms: I have read and accept the <terms>terms and conditions</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

forgot.title: Forgot your password
forgot.intro: Enter the e-mail you registered with. If it has an account, we will send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If {email} has an account with us, a link arrives within minutes. It works for 60 minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: Choose a new password for your account. Every other device will be signed out.

verify.title: Confirm your e-mail
verify.ok: Your e-mail is confirmed. Thank you.
verify.failed: This link is not valid or has expired. Sign in and ask for a new one.

overview.title: My account
overview.intro: Welcome, {name}. Your details, your budget and the units you saved.
overview.notVerified: Your e-mail {email} is not confirmed yet. Confirm it to send a sale request or a unit request.
overview.resent: We sent the link. Check your inbox.
overview.resendFailed: Could not send now. Try again in a minute.
overview.budgetSet: Registered. You can change it any time.
overview.later: Your units for sale and your requests will appear here once selling and unit requests open in later phases.
overview.languageHint: The language of the e-mails we send you.

budget.title: My budget
budget.intro: Tell us the cash you have and the installment you are comfortable with, and our team suggests the units that fit. There are no automatic alerts.
budget.cashHint: What you can pay the owner now.
budget.installmentHint: The amount of one installment you can carry.
budget.targetHint: If you have a ceiling for the original contract price.
budget.areasHint: Choose one to {max} areas or districts.
budget.compoundsHint: Leave empty if any compound in the chosen areas fits.
budget.saved: Your budget was saved. Our team will e-mail you when a unit fits.

favorites.empty: You have not saved any unit yet.
